title: Upstream crosslink observation: kickoff run --container omits the no-prompt permissions flag the docs promise (only 'container start' passes it)

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: SOURCE (attended-design knowledge page, 2026-07-20): 'crosslink kickoff run --container' does not pass --dangerously-skip-permissions — only 'crosslink container start' does — so the documented no-prompt container path holds for one of the two entry points. A container agent launched via kickoff run can hang waiting on permission prompts nobody will answer. NOTE: plausibly a contributor to #837's stall signature (launched-then-never-progresses); if #837 reproduces via kickoff run --container, test this first.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Rolled into the kickoff epic: https://github.com/magnificentlycursed/crosslink/issues/2 (tracks the full vsdd kickoff bundle with upstream dollspace-gay/crosslink links; check-off happens there as upstream fixes land).

comments.content: CLOSED (tracked upstream + registry-carried): filed as dollspace-gay/crosslink#59, fix in flight (their PR #63); the local posture is deviation-registry entry container-kickoff-blocked-posture (retest: upstream #9 or #10 closed — their PR #64 in flight).
